description: This file defines the ProductReviewEntity class, representing product review data within the application. It extends ShopEntity and includes fields for description, product ID, date, and rating, along with their getters and setters. The class is designed for persistence and validation purposes.

classes.name: ProductReviewEntity
classes.description: A Java class representing product reviews, including review details and validation constraints, for use within the sales manager application.

methods.name: getProductId
methods.description: Returns the product ID associated with the review.

methods.name: setProductId
methods.description: Sets the product ID associated with the review.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the date of the review.

methods.name: setDate
methods.description: Sets the date of the review.
